svg.title: What I have built
svg.desc: Thirteen systems for municipal public health, grouped by what they do.
svg.text: Systems running in the Vilhena Municipal Health Department. The code is private because it handles patient data.
Getting paid for the care delivered
Catches errors in hospital and clinic billing before it goes to the Ministry of Health, so the city is not
Keeps the national list of procedures and prices, month by month, as the basis for every calculation.
Shows who is waiting for which exam or surgery, for how long, and what it costs to clear the line.
Real-time view of the city's clinics and emergency units for the management team.
Checks every month that contracted providers did what they billed, before payment is released.
Ready-made documents and review steps for hiring health nonprofits under the national partnership law.
Runs public calls to contract doctors and clinics, from planning to publication on the national portal.
Finds what other public bodies paid for the same item, to set fair prices.
Follows official processes and signatures in the city's e-protocol and warns when something stalls.
Evaluations, grades and records for the city's residency programs in health.
Sign-up and certificates for health-department courses and events.
Pharmacy supply and dispensing control (in testing).
Issues service invoices for small health businesses, checking them before they are sent.
